previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~7-9, w~9-11) with 2 NESTED color-1 (blue) RECTANGULAR FRAMES forming concentric rectangles: an OUTER frame around the grid border, and an INNER frame strictly inside (≥3×3). A few stray color-1 cells may appear elsewhere. Rule: for each non-bg cell, count how many enclosing color-1 rectangular frames surround it (NESTING DEPTH). Recolor each cell to (1 + count): cells at depth 0 (no enclosing frame) become 1, cells inside 1 frame become 2, inside 2 frames become 3, etc. Net: concentric frames get progressively higher colors.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent list of selected square-frame bounding boxes.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Detect every rectangular-frame component, then select only frames whose bounding box has equal height and width.
sequential_dependency.step_b: For each nonzero input cell, output 1 plus the number of selected bounding boxes that contain that cell; keep background cells 0.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The per-cell containment count is computed from the selected frame list, so changing that intermediate set changes final colors on cells enclosed by excluded non-square frames.
